2-UNITNING OXIRGI BETI (16-bet).

⚠ SKAN OGOHLANTIRISHI: bu bet PDF faylida 17-o'rinda - ya'ni 13 va 14-betlardan OLDIN.

Yuqorida chapda ko'k yorliqda oq '2' va yonida 'Night and Day'.

CHAP USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Reading & Listening' sarlavhasi.
22) (kassetа belgisi bilan) 'Read the sentences, then listen and mark them as T (true) or F (false).' Oltita gap, o'ngda nuqtali joy. 1-3 gaplar TIRNOQ ichida (Lizaning so'zlari), 4-6 gaplar oddiy.
23) 'Read the article and number the paragraphs in the correct order, then explain the words in bold.'
Ostida och sariq fonli MAQOLA: sarlavha 'From Rags to Riches'. O'ng yuqorida sariq kofta kiygan, sariq-jigarrang uzun sochli kulib turgan qiz surati.
Maqola to'rt xatboshidan iborat, har birining oldida to'q sariq harf va bo'sh katakcha: [A], [B], [C], [D].
Qalin harfli so'zlar: bright, terraced house, cramped, make ends meet, choir, hired, persuaded, lead the life, privacy, promising career, perform concerts, elegant, constantly on a diet, in shape.

O'NG USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Speaking': 'Read the article again and take notes under the headings THEN and NOW. Then, talk about Liza's home, work, appearance, eating habits and free-time activities.' (ko'k qiya so'zlar bilan)
24) 'Read the dialogue and put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense. Then, in pairs, act out similar dialogues about yourselves.' J (John) va T (Tony) o'rtasidagi dialog, 13 ta nuqtali joy va qavsda fe'llar.
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Vocabulary Revision Game' sarlavhasi.
25) 'In teams, use the words/phrases below to make sentences. Each correct sentence gets one point.' Qiya harfli so'zlar ro'yxati.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '16'.

exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLANING TO'LIQ MATNI VA TARJIMASI
bandlarda TO'G'RI TARTIBDA berilgan.


⚠ SARLAVHA: 'FROM RAGS TO RICHES'

  So'zma-so'z: 'lattadan boylikka'.
  = kambag'allikdan boylikka chiqish.

  ⚠ 'rags' = eski, yirtiq kiyim.
  ⚠ 'riches' = boylik (HAR DOIM
  KO'PLIKDA).

  ⚠ Bu - juda mashhur ingliz iborasi;
  odatda o'zi mehnat qilib boyib ketgan
  odam haqida aytiladi.

  ⚠ O'zbekchada: 'yo'qdan bor bo'ldi'.


⚠ MAQOLANING TO'G'RI TARTIBI
(23-mashqning javobi):

  1 - C  (kirish: Liza kim)
  2 - A  (o'tmish: qanday yashagan)
  3 - D  (bugun: qanday yashaydi)
  4 - B  (xulosa: uning fikri)

  ⚠ Bu - odatiy MAQOLA tuzilishi:
     kirish → o'tmish → hozir → xulosa


⚠ QANDAY TOPILADI:

  C dan boshlanadi, chunki u YaGONA
  xatboshi bo'lib, unda Lizaning TO'LIQ
  ISMI bor: 'Liza Smythe is a successful
  British singer.'
  ⚠ Keyingi xatboshilarda faqat 'Liza'
  yoki 'she' deyilgan - demak ular
  keyin keladi.

  A da 'HOWEVER' bor - qarama-qarshilik
  bog'lovchisi. Demak undan oldin
  ijobiy narsa aytilgan bo'lishi kerak
  (C dagi muvaffaqiyat).

  D 'TODAY' bilan boshlanadi - o'tmishdan
  keyin keladi.

  B - xulosa: 'Liza's lifestyle HAS
  CHANGED a lot SINCE those days' va
  oxirida 'she says'.


⚠ QALIN HARFLI SO'ZLAR:

  bright        = yorqin; iqtidorli
  a terraced house = qatorli uy
  cramped       = tor, siqiq
  to make ends meet = kunini ko'rmoq
  a choir       = xor
  to hire       = yollamoq
  to persuade   = ko'ndirmoq
  to lead the life = hayot kechirmoq
  privacy       = shaxsiy hayot
  a promising career = istiqbolli
                  martaba
  to perform concerts = konsert bermoq
  elegant       = nafis, ozoda
  constantly on a diet = doim parhezda
  in shape      = sport shaklida

points.en: [C] Liza Smythe is a successful British singer. Her smiling face appears on the covers of international magazines, and every year she travels to many different parts of the world to perform concerts for millions of fans.
points.uz: [C] Liza Smit - muvaffaqiyatli britaniyalik qo'shiqchi. Uning kulib turgan yuzi xalqaro jurnallar muqovasida chiqadi va har yili u millionlab muxlislarga konsert berish uchun dunyoning turli burchaklariga sayohat qiladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Bu - BIRINChI xatboshi (kirish).

⚠ Yagona xatboshi bo'lib, unda Lizaning
TO'LIQ ISMI bor - shuning uchun u birinchi.

⚠ 'to perform concerts' - 'to make' EMAS.
⚠ 'a cover' = muqova.

points.en: [A] However, life used to be very different for this bright young star from Liverpool. "Eight years ago," says Liza, "I lived in a small terraced house with my parents and three brothers. It was very cramped!"
points.uz: [A] Ammo bu iqtidorli yosh Liverpul yulduzi uchun hayot ilgari juda boshqacha edi. "Sakkiz yil oldin," - deydi Liza, "ota-onam va uch akam bilan kichkina qatorli uyda yashardim. U juda tor edi!"
points.noteUz:
⚠ Bu - IKKINChI xatboshi.

⚠ 'However' - qarama-qarshilik bog'lovchisi:
demak oldin IJOBIY narsa aytilgan.

⚠ 'a terraced house' = yon devorlari qo'shni
uy bilan umumiy bo'lgan qatorli uy - Britaniyada
juda keng tarqalgan.
⚠ 'cramped' = tor, siqiq.

⚠ 22-mashqning 1-gapida 'a BIG terraced house'
deyilgan - shuning uchun javob F.

points.en: [A] "We didn't have a lot of money, so I used to work as a cleaner at the local hospital to make ends meet. I used to buy my clothes from second-hand shops."
points.uz: [A] "Pulimiz ko'p emas edi, shuning uchun kunimni ko'rish uchun mahalliy kasalxonada farrosh bo'lib ishlardim. Kiyimlarimni ikkinchi qo'l do'konlaridan sotib olardim."
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'used to work' - o'tmishdagi ODAT.
⚠ 'to work AS a cleaner' - kasb oldidan 'as'.
⚠ 'to make ends meet' - IBORA: zo'rg'a kunini
ko'rmoq.
⚠ 'second-hand' = ikkinchi qo'l (ishlatilgan).

points.en: [A] "I was quite plump back then, because I liked eating chips and chocolate. In my free time I used to sing in the college choir or go for walks on the beach."
points.uz: [A] "O'sha paytlar ancha to'ladan kelgan edim, chunki kartoshka fri va shokolad yeyishni yaxshi ko'rardim. Bo'sh vaqtimda kollej xorida kuylardim yoki plyajda sayr qilardim."
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'plump' = to'ladan kelgan (8-betdagi jadvalda
ham bor edi).
⚠ 'back then' = o'sha paytlar.
⚠ 'a choir' - imlosi g'alati, /ˈkwaɪə/ deb
o'qiladi.
⚠ 'to go for a walk' = sayr qilmoq.

points.en: [A] "I didn't use to go to clubs because they were very expensive. I used to listen to the radio a lot, though. I learnt all the words to every pop song and people hired me to sing at parties."
points.uz: [A] "Klublarga bormasdim, chunki ular juda qimmat edi. Lekin radioni ko'p tinglardim. Har bir pop qo'shiqning hamma so'zini yodlab olgandim va odamlar meni bazmlarda kuylashga yollardi."
points.noteUz:
⚠ "didn't USE to" - INKORDA 'use', 'used' EMAS!
⚠ 'though' gap oxirida = 'lekin'.
⚠ 'to hire' = yollamoq.
⚠ 'learnt' - Britaniya shakli ('learned' - AQSh).

points.en: [A] "My friends liked my voice a lot, so they persuaded me to send a cassette to a record company. That's how it all started for me. Three weeks later, I received a phone call from the company and my life changed completely."
points.uz: [A] "Do'stlarimga ovozim juda yoqardi, shuning uchun ular meni yozuv kompaniyasiga kasseta yuborishga ko'ndirishdi. Hammasi shundan boshlandi. Uch hafta o'tib kompaniyadan qo'ng'iroq oldim va hayotim butunlay o'zgardi."
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to persuade sb TO DO sth' - infinitiv bilan.
⚠ 'a record company' = yozuv kompaniyasi.
⚠ "That's how it all started" - turg'un ibora.
⚠ 'completely' = butunlay.

points.en: [D] Today, Liza lives in a large house with a big garden just outside London with her husband and young daughter. She is much slimmer now, and looks very elegant in her chic designer clothes.
points.uz: [D] Bugun Liza turmush o'rtog'i va yosh qizi bilan London chekkasidagi katta bog'li katta uyda yashaydi. U hozir ancha nozikroq va nafis dizayner kiyimlarida juda chiroyli ko'rinadi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Bu - UChINChI xatboshi ('Today' bilan
boshlanadi).

⚠ 22-mashqning 4-gapida 'a large BLOCK OF FLATS'
deyilgan - shuning uchun javob F.

⚠ 'much slimmer' - 'much' qiyosiy darajani
kuchaytiradi.
⚠ 'chic' - fransuzcha, /ʃiːk/ deb o'qiladi.

points.en: [D] She is constantly on a diet and goes to the gym every day to keep her body in shape. In her free time she enjoys going to the theatre or to parties.
points.uz: [D] U doim parhezda va tanasini sport shaklida saqlash uchun har kuni sport zaliga boradi. Bo'sh vaqtida teatrga yoki bazmlarga borishni yoqtiradi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'on a diet' = parhezda.
⚠ 'in shape' = sport shaklida.
⚠ 'to enjoy' dan keyin HAR DOIM -ING.

⚠ 22-mashqning 6-gapida 'the CINEMA' deyilgan -
shuning uchun javob F (matnda 'theatre').

points.en: [B] Liza's lifestyle has changed a lot since those days in Liverpool. "I think I'm very lucky to lead the life I do today. It's not easy, though, because I don't have the privacy that I used to have."
points.uz: [B] Lizaning turmush tarzi Liverpuldagi o'sha kunlardan beri ancha o'zgardi. "Menimcha, bugungi hayotni kechirayotganim uchun juda omadliman. Lekin oson emas, chunki ilgarigi shaxsiy hayotim endi yo'q."
points.noteUz:
⚠ Bu - OXIRGI xatboshi (xulosa).

⚠ 'has changed ... since' - PRESENT PERFECT
(7-unit mavzusi).
⚠ 'to lead a life' = hayot kechirmoq.
⚠ 'privacy' = shaxsiy hayot, tinchlik.

points.en: [B] "Still, I have a lovely family and a very promising career. What else could I ask for?" she says.
points.uz: [B] "Baribir, menda ajoyib oila va juda istiqbolli martaba bor. Yana nima kerak?" - deydi u.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'still' bu yerda = baribir, shunga qaramay.
⚠ 'promising' = istiqbolli ('to promise' -
va'da bermoq).
⚠ 'What else could I ask for?' - ritorik savol:
'bundan ortiq nima kerak?'

exercises.instructionEn: Read the sentences, then listen and mark them as T (true) or F (false).
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni o'qing, so'ng tinglang va T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) deb belgilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR MAQOLADA BOR.

  ⚠ Kassetada shu maqola o'qiladi -
  mashqni AUDIOSIZ ham bajarish mumkin.


⚠ T/F MAShQINING ASOSIY TUZOG'I -
ALMAShTIRILGAN SO'Z:

  1  matn: 'a SMALL terraced house'
     savol: 'a BIG terraced house' → F

  4  matn: 'a large HOUSE with a big
        garden'
     savol: 'a large BLOCK OF FLATS' → F

  6  matn: 'going to the THEATRE or to
        parties'
     savol: 'going to the CINEMA' → F

  ⚠ Uchala xatoda ham FAQAT BITTA so'z
  o'zgargan - shuning uchun matnni
  DIQQAT bilan solishtirish kerak.


⚠ TO'G'RI GAPLAR:

  2  'I used to work as a cleaner at the
     local hospital.' - matnda AYNAN
     shunday → T

  3  "I didn't use to go to clubs." -
     matnda AYNAN shunday → T

  5  'She looks very elegant in her chic
     designer clothes.' - matnda
     AYNAN shunday → T


⚠ 'A BLOCK OF FLATS':

  = ko'p qavatli turar joy binosi.
  ⚠ Britaniya varianti; AQShda
  'an apartment building'.

items.sentence: 1  "Eight years ago I lived in a big terraced house."
items.whyUz:
NOTO'G'RI. Matnda: 'I lived in a SMALL terraced
house with my parents and three brothers. It was
very CRAMPED!'

⚠ 'small' → 'big' deb almashtirilgan.

items.sentence: 2  "I used to work as a cleaner at the local hospital."
items.whyUz:
TO'G'RI. Matnda AYNAN shunday: 'I used to work as
a cleaner at the local hospital to make ends meet.'

items.sentence: 3  "I didn't use to go to clubs."
items.whyUz:
TO'G'RI. Matnda: "I didn't use to go to clubs
because they were very expensive."

⚠ E'tibor bering: INKORDA 'USE', 'used' emas.

items.sentence: 4  Today Liza lives in a large block of flats.
items.whyUz:
NOTO'G'RI. Matnda: 'Liza lives in a large HOUSE
with a big garden just outside London.'

⚠ 'a block of flats' = ko'p qavatli turar joy
binosi - butunlay boshqa narsa.

items.sentence: 5  She looks very elegant in her chic designer clothes.
items.whyUz:
TO'G'RI. Matnda AYNAN shunday: 'looks very
elegant in her chic designer clothes'.

⚠ 'chic' - fransuzcha, /ʃiːk/ deb o'qiladi.

items.sentence: 6  She enjoys going to the cinema.
items.whyUz:
NOTO'G'RI. Matnda: 'she enjoys going to the
THEATRE or to parties'.

⚠ 'theatre' → 'cinema' deb almashtirilgan.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the article and number the paragraphs in the correct order, then explain the words in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: Maqolani o'qing va xatboshilarni to'g'ri tartibda raqamlang, so'ng qalin harfli so'zlarni tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLA TUZILIShI:

  KIRISh → O'TMISh → HOZIR → XULOSA


QANDAY TOPILADI - UCh BELGI:

  1) TO'LIQ ISM birinchi xatboshida
     bo'ladi:
     C: 'LIZA SMYTHE is a successful
        British singer.'
     ⚠ Qolganlarida faqat 'Liza' yoki
     'she'.

  2) BOG'LOVChI SO'ZLAR:
     A: 'HOWEVER, life USED TO BE very
        different' - qarama-qarshilik +
        o'tmish
     D: 'TODAY, Liza lives ...' - hozir
     B: 'has changed a lot SINCE those
        days' - xulosa

  3) ZAMONLAR:
     C - present simple (doimiy holat)
     A - past simple / used to (o'tmish)
     D - present simple (hozirgi holat)
     B - present perfect (o'zgarish
        natijasi)


⚠ NIMA UChUN 'B' OXIRIDA:

  B da UMUMLAShTIRUVChI fikr bor:
  'What else could I ask for?' -
  bu ritorik savol, xulosaga xos.

  ⚠ Yana B da 'SINCE those days in
  Liverpool' deyilgan - demak
  Liverpul haqida allaqachon aytilgan
  (A xatboshida).

pairs.right: C - Liza Smythe is a successful British singer.
pairs.rightUz: C - Liza Smit muvaffaqiyatli britaniyalik qo'shiqchi.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Yagona xatboshi bo'lib, unda TO'LIQ ISM bor.

⚠ Maqola KIRISh bilan boshlanadi: kim haqida
gap ketyapti.

pairs.right: A - However, life used to be very different ...
pairs.rightUz: A - Ammo hayot ilgari juda boshqacha edi ...
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'HOWEVER' - qarama-qarshilik bog'lovchisi:
oldin IJOBIY narsa aytilgan bo'lishi kerak.

⚠ 'used to be' - O'TMISh haqida.

pairs.right: D - Today, Liza lives in a large house ...
pairs.rightUz: D - Bugun Liza katta uyda yashaydi ...
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'TODAY' bilan boshlanadi - o'tmishdan keyin
keladi.

⚠ Zamon: present simple (hozirgi holat).

pairs.right: B - Liza's lifestyle has changed a lot since those days ...
pairs.rightUz: B - Lizaning turmush tarzi o'sha kunlardan beri ancha o'zgardi ...
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ XULOSA: 'SINCE those days in Liverpool' -
demak Liverpul haqida allaqachon aytilgan.

⚠ Ritorik savol 'What else could I ask for?' -
xulosaga xos.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the article again and take notes under the headings THEN and NOW. Then, talk about Liza's home, work, appearance, eating habits and free-time activities.
exercises.instructionUz: Maqolani qayta o'qing va THEN (o'sha payt) va NOW (hozir) sarlavhalari ostida qayd oling. So'ng Lizaning uyi, ishi, tashqi qiyofasi, ovqatlanish odati va bo'sh vaqt mashg'ulotlari haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
'THEN' VA 'NOW' - QIYoSLASh.

  ⚠ 15-betdagi 20-mashq bilan bir xil
  g'oya: o'tmish va hozirni solishtirish.


GAPIRISh QOLIPI:

  'Liza used to ... , but now she ... '

  yoki

  'She didn't use to ... , but now
   she ... '

  ⚠ 'used to' - o'tmish uchun
  ⚠ present simple - hozir uchun


BESh MAVZU:

  home (uy)
  work (ish)
  appearance (tashqi qiyofa)
  eating habits (ovqatlanish odati)
  free-time activities (bo'sh vaqt)

  ⚠ Bandlarda har mavzu bo'yicha
  THEN va NOW berilgan.


⚠ 'EATING HABITS':

  = ovqatlanish odatlari.
  ⚠ 'a habit' = odat.
  ⚠ 'to eat' + -ING sifat vazifasida.

points.en: HOME - THEN: a small, cramped terraced house in Liverpool with her parents and three brothers. NOW: a large house with a big garden just outside London with her husband and daughter.
points.uz: UY - O'ShA PAYT: Liverpulda ota-onasi va uch akasi bilan kichkina, tor qatorli uy. HOZIR: London chekkasida turmush o'rtog'i va qizi bilan katta bog'li katta uy.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Gap: 'Liza used to live in a small terraced
house, but now she lives in a large house.'

⚠ 'just outside London' = London chekkasida.

points.en: WORK - THEN: she used to work as a cleaner at the local hospital. NOW: she is a successful singer and performs concerts around the world.
points.uz: ISH - O'ShA PAYT: mahalliy kasalxonada farrosh bo'lib ishlardi. HOZIR: muvaffaqiyatli qo'shiqchi va dunyo bo'ylab konsert beradi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to work AS' - kasb oldidan 'as'.
⚠ 'to perform concerts' - 'to make' EMAS.

points.en: APPEARANCE - THEN: she was quite plump and bought her clothes from second-hand shops. NOW: she is much slimmer and looks elegant in chic designer clothes.
points.uz: TASHQI QIYOFA - O'ShA PAYT: ancha to'ladan kelgan edi va kiyimlarini ikkinchi qo'l do'konlaridan olardi. HOZIR: ancha nozikroq va nafis dizayner kiyimlarida chiroyli ko'rinadi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'much slimmer' - 'much' qiyosiy darajani
kuchaytiradi ('very slimmer' XATO).
⚠ 'plump' - 8-betdagi jadvalda ham bor edi.

points.en: EATING HABITS - THEN: she liked eating chips and chocolate. NOW: she is constantly on a diet.
points.uz: OVQATLANISH ODATI - O'ShA PAYT: kartoshka fri va shokolad yeyishni yaxshi ko'rardi. HOZIR: doim parhezda.

points.en: FREE-TIME ACTIVITIES - THEN: she used to sing in the college choir, go for walks on the beach and listen to the radio; she didn't use to go to clubs. NOW: she goes to the gym every day and enjoys going to the theatre or to parties.
points.uz: BO'SH VAQT - O'ShA PAYT: kollej xorida kuylardi, plyajda sayr qilardi va radio tinglardi; klublarga bormasdi. HOZIR: har kuni sport zaliga boradi, teatrga va bazmlarga borishni yoqtiradi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to go for a walk' = sayr qilmoq.
⚠ 'a choir' - /ˈkwaɪə/ deb o'qiladi.
⚠ 'to enjoy' dan keyin HAR DOIM -ING.

points.en: Liza used to work as a cleaner, but now she is a successful singer.
points.uz: Liza ilgari farrosh bo'lib ishlardi, hozir esa muvaffaqiyatli qo'shiqchi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ GAPIRISh QOLIPI: 'used to' + fe'l,
but now + present simple.

⚠ Har mavzu uchun shunday bitta gap tuzing.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the dialogue and put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense. Then, in pairs, act out similar dialogues about yourselves.
exercises.instructionUz: Dialogni o'qing va qavsdagi fe'llarni to'g'ri zamonga qo'ying. So'ng juftlikda o'zingiz haqingizda shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
JON VA TONINING TANIShUVI.

  Toni - italiyalik, Glazgo
  universitetida tibbiyot o'qiydi.


⚠ ZAMONNI QANDAY TANLASh:

  PRESENT SIMPLE - doimiy holat, odat:
     'Where DO you COME from?'
     'I COME from Italy.'
     'Where DO you STUDY?'
     'DO you GO to lectures every day?'
     'They START at 9:30.'
     'How DO you TRAVEL ...?'

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS - vaqtinchalik
  holat va yaqin reja:
     'What ARE you STUDYING?'
        (hozirgi o'quv kursi)
     'What ARE you DOING this evening?'
        (bugungi reja)
     "I'M STUDYING for a test."
     "I'M MEETING some friends."
     "We'RE GOING to a new club."


⚠ 3 va 5-BANDLARNING FARQI:

  3: 'What ARE you STUDYING?'
     = hozir qaysi fanni o'qiyapsiz?
     (vaqtinchalik - kurs tugaydi)

  5: 'Where DO you STUDY?'
     = qayerda o'qiysiz?
     (doimiy - universitet o'zgarmaydi)

  ⚠ Bir xil fe'l, ikki xil zamon -
  butun mashqning maqsadi shu.


⚠ 11, 12, 13-BANDLAR - BUGUNGI REJA:

  'I'm studying for a test, then I'm
   meeting some friends. We're going to
   a new club in town.'

  ⚠ Uchalasi ham PRESENT CONTINUOUS,
  chunki bular ANIQ, kelishilgan
  rejalar (10-betdagi 'd' qo'llanishi).


⚠ 'WHERE DO YOU COME FROM?':

  = qayerliksiz?
  ⚠ 'Where are you from?' bilan bir xil
  ma'no.
  ⚠ 'from' HAR DOIM oxirida qoladi.


⚠ 'MEDICINE':

  = tibbiyot (fan); dori.
  ⚠ Fan nomi sifatida ARTIKLSIZ:
  'I study Medicine.'


⚠ 'A LECTURE':

  = ma'ruza (universitetda).
  ⚠ 'a lesson' - maktabda,
  'a lecture' - universitetda.


⚠ 'BY BUS' - ARTIKLSIZ:

  'How do you travel? - By bus.'
  ⚠ 14-betdagi 15-mashqda ham shu qolip.

lines.speaker: J
lines.whyUz:
⚠ Bu qatorda bo'shliq yo'q.
⚠ 'Hi' - norasmiy salomlashuv.

lines.speaker: T
lines.whyUz:
⚠ Avval ism, keyin to'liq ism-familiya -
tabiiy tanishuv usuli.

lines.speaker: J
lines.whyUz:
⚠ DOIMIY holat → PRESENT SIMPLE.
⚠ 'from' HAR DOIM oxirida.

lines.speaker: T
lines.whyUz:
⚠ Ega 'I' - -S YO'Q.
⚠ 'I'm from Italy' ham to'g'ri.

lines.speaker: J
lines.whyUz:
⚠ VAQTINChALIK holat (kurs tugaydi) →
PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

⚠ 5-band bilan SOLIShTIRING: u yerda
'do you study' - doimiy joy.

lines.speaker: T
lines.en: Medicine. I 4) ___ (want) to become a doctor.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 'want' - HOLAT fe'li, CONTINUOUS shaklda
ISHLATILMAYDI.
⚠ 'want TO DO sth' - infinitiv bilan.

lines.speaker: J
lines.whyUz:
⚠ DOIMIY joy → PRESENT SIMPLE.

⚠ 3-band bilan SOLIShTIRING: bir xil fe'l,
boshqa zamon, boshqa ma'no.

lines.speaker: T
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 'AT university' - predlog 'at'.
⚠ Glazgo - Shotlandiyaning eng katta shahri.

lines.speaker: J
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 'every day' - ODAT → PRESENT SIMPLE.
⚠ Gap boshida bo'lgani uchun KATTA harf.
⚠ 'a lecture' = ma'ruza (universitetda).

lines.speaker: T
lines.uz: Ha. Ular 9:30 da boshlanadi va 2:30 da tugaydi.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ JADVAL bo'yicha doimiy vaqt → PRESENT SIMPLE.
⚠ Ega 'They' - KO'PLIK, -S YO'Q.

lines.speaker: J
lines.whyUz:
⚠ ODAT → PRESENT SIMPLE.
⚠ 'to and from' = borib-kelish.

lines.speaker: J
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 'this evening' - YAQIN KELAJAKDAGI REJA →
PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

⚠ 10-betdagi 'd' qo'llanishi.

lines.speaker: T
lines.en: I 11) ___ (study) for a test, then I 12) ___ (meet) some friends. We 13) ___ (go) to a new club in town.
lines.uz: Testga tayyorlanaman, keyin do'stlarim bilan uchrashaman. Shahardagi yangi klubga boramiz.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ Uchalasi ham ANIQ, KELIShILGAN reja →
PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

⚠ 'to study FOR a test' - predlog 'for'.
⚠ 'in town' - artiklsiz turg'un ibora.

exercises.instructionEn: In teams, use the words/phrases below to make sentences. Each correct sentence gets one point.
exercises.instructionUz: Guruhlarga bo'linib, quyidagi so'z va iboralar bilan gap tuzing. Har bir to'g'ri gap uchun bir ochko.
exercises.explanationUz:
2-UNITNING BUTUN LUG'ATI.

  ⚠ 17 ta so'z/ibora - hammasi
  12-16-betlarda uchragan.


⚠ NIMA UChUN GAP TUZISh KERAK:

  So'zni ALOHIDA yodlash tez unutiladi.
  O'ZINGIZ tuzgan gap xotirada kontekst
  bilan bog'lanadi va uzoq qoladi
  ('generation effect').


⚠ QIYIN IBORALAR:

  in orbit - ARTIKLSIZ
  aboard a space shuttle - 'on board'
     ning qisqasi
  to make ends meet - kunini ko'rmoq
  in shape - sport shaklida
  to have privacy - shaxsiy hayotga
     ega bo'lmoq
  to take over for the night - tun uchun
     navbatni olmoq

  ⚠ Bularni SO'ZMA-SO'Z tarjima qilmang -
  ular IBORA.

modelSentences.sentence: The space shuttle stays in orbit for two weeks.
modelSentences.uz: Kosmik kema ikki hafta orbitada qoladi.

modelSentences.sentence: Astronauts do two six-hour space walks every day.
modelSentences.uz: Kosmonavtlar har kuni ikkita olti soatlik kosmik sayr qiladi.

modelSentences.sentence: We take a short break for lunch at one o'clock.
modelSentences.uz: Soat birda tushlik uchun qisqa tanaffus qilamiz.

modelSentences.sentence: The crew of the plane welcomed the passengers.
Life aboard a space shuttle is very busy.
I often sit by the window and admire the view.
modelSentences.uz: Men ko'pincha deraza yonida o'tirib manzaraga zavq bilan qarayman.

modelSentences.sentence: Liza received a phone call from the record company.
She looks elegant in her designer clothes.
Their old house was very small and cramped.
modelSentences.uz: Ularning eski uyi juda kichkina va tor edi.

modelSentences.sentence: Famous people don't have much privacy.
modelSentences.uz: Mashhur odamlarning shaxsiy hayoti kam bo'ladi.

modelSentences.sentence: She goes to the gym every day to keep in shape.
modelSentences.uz: U shaklini saqlash uchun har kuni sport zaliga boradi.

modelSentences.sentence: He works two jobs to make ends meet.
modelSentences.uz: U kunini ko'rish uchun ikki joyda ishlaydi.

modelSentences.sentence: The young singer has a very promising career.
The night staff take over for the night at ten o'clock.
modelSentences.uz: Tungi smena soat o'nda navbatni oladi.

modelSentences.sentence: My friends persuaded me to join the choir.
She performs concerts all over the world.
modelSentences.uz: U butun dunyo bo'ylab konsert beradi.

modelSentences.sentence: They used to live in a small terraced house in Liverpool.
modelSentences.uz: Ular ilgari Liverpulda kichkina qatorli uyda yashashardi.

sentencePatterns.introUz: O'tmish va hozirni qiyoslash, tanishuv savollari.

patterns.exampleEn: Liza used to work as a cleaner, but now she is a successful singer.
patterns.exampleUz: Liza ilgari farrosh bo'lib ishlardi, hozir esa muvaffaqiyatli qo'shiqchi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ O'tmish va hozirni qiyoslashning asosiy qolipi.
⚠ 'work AS' - kasb oldidan 'as'.

patterns.formula: Where do you come from? - I come from [mamlakat].
patterns.exampleEn: Where do you come from? - I come from Italy.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'from' HAR DOIM oxirida.
⚠ 'Where are you from?' bilan bir xil ma'no.

patterns.formula: What are you studying? / Where do you study?
patterns.exampleEn: What are you studying? - Medicine. Where do you study? - At Glasgow University.
patterns.exampleUz: Nima o'qiyapsiz? - Tibbiyot. Qayerda o'qiysiz? - Glazgo universitetida.

patterns.formula: What are you doing this evening? - I'm [fe'l]-ing.
patterns.exampleEn: What are you doing this evening? - I'm meeting some friends.
patterns.exampleUz: Bugun kechqurun nima qilasiz? - Do'stlarim bilan uchrashaman.

patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'much' qiyosiy darajani kuchaytiradi.
⚠ 'very slimmer' - XATO ('very' faqat oddiy
sifat bilan).
